name: Ждан, пахарь
desc: a peasant plowman of about 40, sunburnt weathered face, short brown beard, patched linen shirt, rough brown wool trousers, bast shoes with foot wraps, a wooden hoe resting on his shoulder
note: Пахарь из Придорожного, жалуется на поля без договора и на полуденный зной.
mapPose: standing with the hoe on his shoulder
amb: wipes the sweat from his forehead with his sleeve

name: Веся, крестьянка
desc: a peasant woman of about 30, round tired face, light brown braid under a faded red headscarf, plain grey linen dress with an embroidered collar, a wicker basket with turnips on her arm
note: Жена пахаря, носит репу на рынок, знает все сплетни деревни.
mapPose: standing with the basket on her arm
amb: shifts the basket to the other arm and sighs

name: Дед Мокей
desc: a very old stooped peasant man of about 80, bald head with wisps of white hair, long thin white beard, worn sheepskin vest over a long linen shirt, leaning on a crooked wooden cane
note: Старейший в деревне, помнит, как ставили первые печати на дороге.
mapPose: standing bent, leaning on the cane
amb: coughs and leans harder on the cane

name: Тимко, мальчишка
desc: a barefoot village boy of about 10, tousled straw-blond hair, freckles, oversized patched shirt with a rope belt, holding a wooden toy sword, curious face
note: Бегает за героем, мечтает стать дуэлянтом, носит слухи за медяк.
mapPose: standing with the wooden toy sword lowered
amb: swings the wooden toy sword once in the air

name: Ганка, девочка
desc: a small village girl of about 7, dark hair in two braids, a long faded blue linen dress, barefoot, holding a rag doll to her chest, serious shy face
note: Сирота с выселка, ищет пропавшего брата; ключ к квесту погорельцев.
amb: hugs the rag doll closer and looks around

name: Ерёма, пастух
desc: a young shepherd of about 20, lanky, shaggy dark hair, a felt hat, a grey wool cloak over a linen shirt, a long crooked shepherd staff, a birch-bark horn on a cord
note: Пасёт деревенское стадо, видел Полудницу и пугало, которое двигается.
amb: lifts the horn to his lips and blows it briefly

name: Гнат, дровосек
desc: a big burly woodcutter of about 45, black beard, bald head, a sleeveless leather jerkin over a rough shirt, thick arms, a woodcutter axe resting on his shoulder
note: Рубит на краю Старого Бора, оставляет хлеб на пне для Лешего.
mapPose: standing with the axe on his shoulder
amb: rolls his shoulders, the axe stays on his shoulder

name: Прокоп, мельник
desc: a plump miller of about 55, round face, grey mustache, a floury apron over a brown tunic, sleeves rolled up, a flat cap, flour dust on his clothes and arms
note: Мельник, держит закрома и долговые бирки половины деревни.
mapPose: standing with hands on his belly
amb: pats the flour dust off his apron

name: Сыч, могильщик
desc: a gaunt gravedigger of about 60, hollow cheeks, long greasy grey hair, a long patched black coat, muddy boots, an iron shovel in his hands
note: Копает на погосте у склепа, знает, кто встаёт за долгом.
amb: pushes the shovel into the ground and leans on it

name: Олена, вдова
desc: a widow of about 40, pale stern face, a black wool headscarf and a long black dress, a grey shawl, holding a wax candle in her hands, mourning
note: Вдова погибшего на заставе, просит найти тело мужа.
mapPose: standing, holding the candle in both hands
amb: lowers her head over the candle in prayer

name: Осока, рыбак
desc: a swamp fisherman of about 50, weathered face, grey stubble, a wide reed hat, a patched oilskin coat, tall wet leather boots, a fishing net over his shoulder and a wooden fish trap in hand
note: Рыбачит на старой воде, не светит фонарём в воду и другим не велит.
mapPose: standing with the net over his shoulder
amb: adjusts the net on his shoulder

name: Слепой Онисим
desc: a blind beggar of about 60, a dirty grey cloth band over his eyes, ragged layered rags, barefoot with foot wraps, holding out a wooden bowl, a walking stick under his arm
note: Слепой нищий у развилки, слышит больше, чем зрячие; продаёт слухи за медь.
mapPose: standing, holding out the wooden bowl
amb: shakes the bowl a little, listening for coins

name: Мытарь Кондрат
desc: a toll collector of about 45, thin suspicious face, small eyes, a dark green wool coat with tarnished brass buttons, a leather satchel of coins, a ledger book under his arm, a quill behind his ear
note: Собирает пошлину на заставе у моста, берёт взятки, записывает всех в книгу.
mapPose: standing with the ledger under his arm
amb: opens the ledger, looks into it and closes it

name: Сестра Агафья
desc: a wandering nun of about 35, calm face, a grey wool habit with a hood, a rope belt with a wooden prayer string, a small iron lantern in her hand, a travel bag on her back
note: Паломница, идёт к Граду, ставит свечи у сорванных печатей; лечит за милостыню.
mapPose: standing with the lantern in her hand
amb: raises the lantern a little and looks into the distance

name: Злата, травница
desc: a herbalist woman of about 45, sharp clever face, dark hair with grey streaks under a green kerchief, a moss-green dress, a leather apron with many little pouches, bundles of dried herbs hanging from her belt, holding a clay jar
note: Торгует травами, мазями и настоями; учит Знахарку горьким рецептам.
amb: smells the clay jar and nods

name: Ефим, лавочник
desc: a shopkeeper of about 50, balding with a fringe of dark hair, neat beard, a brown waistcoat over a white shirt, sleeves gartered, spectacles, holding a small wooden abacus
note: Лавка в Придорожном: верёвки, соль, свечи, фляги; торгуется до последнего медяка.
amb: clicks a few beads on the abacus

name: Гримм Весы, гномий меняла
desc: a dwarf money changer, short and stout, long braided grey beard with copper rings, a fur-trimmed dark red coat, a heavy purse on his belt, small brass scales in one hand, a jeweler loupe on a chain
note: Меняет горное серебро на имперскую медь, скупает печатки и кольца.
amb: weighs something on the brass scales and squints

name: Лука, коробейник
desc: a traveling peddler of about 35, cheerful sly face, a battered felt hat with a feather, a patched coat, a big wooden pack box on his back full of ribbons, pots and trinkets
note: Ходит от таверны до болота; продаёт мелочь и приносит письма.
mapPose: standing with the pack box on his back
amb: hitches the pack box higher on his back

name: Хорт, скупщик шкур
desc: a northern fur trader of about 45, broad face, braided blond beard, a heavy wolf-fur cloak, leather coat, a stack of furs over one shoulder, a hunting knife on his belt
note: Скупает шкуры у охотников деревни у озера, знает, кто из них ходит волком.
mapPose: standing with the furs over his shoulder
amb: strokes the furs on his shoulder

name: Сава, точильщик
desc: a knife grinder of about 55, wiry, a leather cap, a soot-stained leather apron, rolled sleeves, a portable wooden grinding wheel frame on his back, a whetstone in hand
note: Бродячий точильщик: правит клинки, продаёт точильные камни и масло.
mapPose: standing with the whetstone in hand
amb: runs the whetstone along his thumb nail checking it

name: Борин, кузнец-гном
desc: a dwarf blacksmith, very broad and muscular, short black beard singed at the ends, bald head, a heavy leather apron, bare arms with burn scars, holding tongs and a small hammer
note: Горный кузнец, кует доспех из меди шахты; не похож на Тила: старый клан, другая школа.
amb: taps the small hammer on the tongs

name: Стражник Града
desc: a city guard of Grad, steel kettle helmet, a dull mail shirt under a faded dark blue tabard with a pale tower emblem, leather gloves, a long spear and a tall wooden kite shield
note: Стража Града: на воротах и в бою grad_guards.
mapPose: standing with the spear upright and the shield
weapons: one long spear in the front hand, one tall wooden kite shield on the rear arm
amb: shifts the shield on his arm and looks around

name: Арбалетчик Града
desc: a city crossbowman of Grad, a padded gambeson, a faded dark blue tabard with a pale tower emblem, an open steel helmet, a quiver of bolts at the hip, a heavy crossbow
note: Стрелок стражи Града (бой grad_guards, стены).
mapPose: standing with the crossbow held low
weapons: one heavy crossbow held with both hands, pointing to the right
amb: checks the crossbow string with his fingers

name: Наёмник-пикинёр
desc: a mercenary pikeman, scarred tough face, a dented steel morion helmet, a patched brown doublet with a rusty breastplate, puffed striped sleeves faded, a long pike
note: Наёмники Бурого: нанимаются к тому, кто платит, на дороге и у перевала.
weapons: one long pike held with both hands, pointing to the right

name: Бурый, капитан наёмников
desc: a mercenary captain of about 45, broad brown beard, a brown leather coat over a blackened breastplate, a wide hat with a ragged feather, a long sword
note: Капитан вольной роты; можно нанять, перекупить или разбить (босс дороги).
mapPose: standing with the hand on the sword hilt
weapons: one long sword in the front hand, the rear hand empty
amb: looks around and strokes his beard

name: Поножовщик
desc: a road bandit knife fighter, lean and twitchy, a dirty grey hood, a scarf over the lower face, a stained leather vest, bare forearms with scars, a long knife
note: Разбойник с ножом, из тех, кто режет кошельки у таверны.
weapons: one long knife in the front hand, the rear hand empty
amb: tosses the knife a little in his hand and catches it by the handle

name: Браконьер
desc: a poacher bandit, a green-brown hooded cloak, a leather jerkin, a quiver on the back, a hunting short bow, rabbit pelts on his belt
note: Браконьер Старого Бора; стреляет в спину, ходит с волками и разбойниками.
weapons: one short bow held in the front hand, the rear hand free to draw the string

name: Вешка, разбойница
desc: a woman bandit of about 30, a hard scarred face, short red hair, a padded jerkin with leather patches, a bandolier with knives, a hand axe
note: Разбойница, бывшая маркитантка; ведёт малую шайку у сгоревшего выселка.
mapPose: standing with the axe resting on her shoulder
weapons: one hand axe in the front hand, the rear hand empty
amb: lowers the axe from her shoulder and lifts it back

name: Послушник сорванной печати
desc: a cultist acolyte of the Torn Seal, a young pale man with a shaved head, a long undyed sackcloth robe, a cord belt with broken wax seals hanging from it, a censer on a chain
note: Культ тех, кто срывает дорожные печати ради Забытого; ходят по двое у сорванных печатей.
mapPose: standing with the censer hanging low
weapons: one iron censer on a chain in the front hand, the rear hand empty
amb: swings the censer slowly once

name: Фанатик с крюком
desc: a cult zealot of the Torn Seal, a gaunt man with wax smeared over his eyelids, a ragged dark grey robe, broken wax seals sewn to the chest, a long iron hook on a wooden shaft
note: Боевой фанатик культа: идёт первым, не чувствует боли.
weapons: one long iron hook on a wooden shaft held with both hands

name: Пастырь Безымянных
desc: the cult priest of the Torn Seal, a tall old man with a long grey beard, a heavy dark purple-grey robe with a hood, a mask of melted wax covering half of his face, a staff topped with a cracked seal disk
note: Глава культа сорванной печати (босс); говорит, что помнит имена, которые все забыли.
weapons: the staff with the cracked seal disk in the rear hand, the front hand free for a gesture
amb: raises the free hand slowly as if blessing

name: Водяной
desc: the vodyanoy, the old master of old water: a fat old man with greenish wet skin, a long beard of water weeds and duckweed, small fish-like eyes, webbed fingers, a rotten tall hat, a sodden old caftan, sitting on a big old green bronze church bell
note: Хозяин старой воды в утопшей деревне; торгует вещами с утонувших телег за монету или за имя.
mapPose: sitting on the old bronze bell
amb: scratches his weed beard and chuckles

name: Бродячий рыцарь
desc: a wandering knight without a lord: worn dark steel plate armor, a closed great helm with a narrow visor, a tattered surcoat whose coat of arms is painted over with black paint, a long sword and a battered heater shield
note: Ищет честной дуэли с героем (три дуэли за игру); вызывает один на один.
mapPose: standing with the sword point on the ground
weapons: one long sword in the front hand, one battered heater shield on the rear arm
amb: lifts the sword a little and lowers the point back to the ground

name: Ырка
desc: the yrka, a night road spirit of a murdered traveler: a gaunt grey-skinned man in a rotten traveler coat, pale empty eyes without pupils, very long thin arms, hunched, barefoot
note: Ночной дух убитого путника; нападает на тех, кто идёт дорогой ночью один.
weapons: no weapon, long bony fingers on both hands

name: Шишига
desc: a shishiga, a small mischievous swamp-forest creature: hunched, skinny, wet matted dark hair hanging over the face, long arms, pale grey-green skin, ragged reed skirt, sharp small teeth
note: Мелкая нечисть болота: ходит стайкой, ворует и кусает, пугается огня.
weapons: no weapon, small claws on both hands

name: Полевик
desc: the polevik, a small old field spirit: a little old man with dry dark earth-colored skin, hair and beard of wheat straw and grass, a white linen shirt stained with soil, a belt of rye ears, sly eyes
note: Хозяин поля, младший сосед Полудницы; путает межи, мирится за хлеб и соль.
weapons: no weapon, both hands free for gestures
amb: pulls a straw from his beard and chews it

name: Пугало
desc: a living scarecrow of the noon field: a cross of old wood dressed in a torn peasant coat and a battered straw hat, a burlap sack head with stitched eyes, straw sticking out of the sleeves, a rusty sickle tied to one arm
note: Пугало на поле у деревни: по его тени видно время; в полдень Полудница его поднимает.
weapons: one rusty sickle tied to the front arm, the rear hand straw fingers
amb: the head slowly tilts to the side and back

name: Кляча
desc: a tired old bay draft horse with a dark mane, a worn leather harness and a horse collar, shaggy hooves, side view
note: Тягловая лошадь у таверны и у мельницы; можно купить для повозки.
amb: lowers the head, snorts and shakes the mane

name: Корова
desc: a thin brown and white village cow with a wooden bell on a rope, short horns, side view
note: Деревенская корова.
amb: lowers the head and chews, the tail swishes

name: Коза
desc: a scruffy grey village goat with a beard and curved horns, a rope around the neck, side view
note: Коза у двора, бодается.
amb: bleats and shakes its head

name: Ворон
desc: a big black raven with ruffled feathers, perched standing on the ground, side view
note: Вороны на виселичном холме и у полей; вестники беды.
amb: hops once in place and caws

name: Подсвинок
desc: a young wild boar, a yearling, bristly dark brown fur with faint stripes, small tusks, side view
note: Молодой кабан из выводка Вепря; стайка подсвинков в лесу.
weapons: no weapon, small tusks
amb: sniffs and roots the ground with the snout

name: Лиса
desc: a lean red fox with a bushy tail and black legs, side view
note: Лиса у курятника и в поле.
amb: sits back and scratches behind the ear with a hind leg, then stands

name: Олень
desc: a red deer stag with large antlers, brown coat, side view
note: Олень Старого Бора, его не трогают из-за Лешего.
amb: lowers the head to graze and lifts it again

name: Медведь-шатун
desc: a shatun, a gaunt starving brown bear woken from hibernation in winter, matted patchy fur, ribs visible, frost on the fur, mad hungry eyes, on four legs, side view
note: Не залёгший зимой медведь: голодный, злой, бродит у деревень севера. Не путать с Лесным Дедом.
weapons: no weapon, claws and jaws
amb: sniffs the air and shakes the frost from its fur

name: Рысь
desc: a Eurasian lynx with spotted grey-tan fur, black ear tufts, short tail, on four legs, side view
note: Рысь Старого Бора: бросается сверху на задний ряд.
weapons: no weapon, claws and fangs
amb: licks a front paw and puts it down

name: Сова
desc: a large eagle owl with brown mottled feathers and orange eyes, ear tufts, perched standing on a stump, side view
note: Сова в лесу и на руинах; ночной вестник.
amb: turns the head far to the side and back, blinks

name: Крысы
desc: a pack of three big grey-brown sewer rats with long naked tails, huddled together on the ground, side view
note: Крысы из запечатанного подвала таверны (бой: стая из трёх как один юнит).
weapons: no weapon, teeth
amb: the rats sniff around, whiskers twitching

name: Снежный волк
desc: a northern snow wolf with thick white-grey fur, pale eyes, lean and long-legged, on four legs, side view
note: Стая у озера на севере (бой winter_wolves).
weapons: no weapon, fangs
amb: lowers the head and sniffs the ground

name: Вожак снежной стаи
desc: a huge old snow wolf pack leader with thick grey-white fur, a torn ear, old scars across the muzzle, a heavy mane, on four legs, side view
note: Вожак: вой даёт стае инициативу (босс winter_wolves).
weapons: no weapon, fangs
